observation.command:
# Stop current dev servers
for pid in 117533 122745; do kill -TERM -- -$pid 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 8
ps aux | grep -E "run-executor|nx.js" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null
sleep 5
for p in 39001 39002 39003; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
